about: Seeded documents for scripts/figures_check.py in sourcing mode. Each case has a register, a reference text and a document; bad lists the figures in the document that are not sourced (unsourced, wrongly rounded, glued table cells, wrong arithmetic). Every other figure the checker reads in the document is correct. A good checker flags the bad ones (recall) and leaves the rest (precision).
